items.question: What are Sevgi Uzun's WNBA career averages?
items.answer: Sevgi Uzun averaged 3.9 points, 1.5 rebounds and 2.8 assists in 65 WNBA regular-season games over 2024 and 2025. As a rookie with the Dallas Wings in 2024, she averaged 4.4 points and 3.0 assists in 40 games.

items.question: Which WNBA teams has Sevgi Uzun played for?
items.answer: Sevgi Uzun has played for the Dallas Wings, Phoenix Mercury and Chicago Sky.

items.question: Did Sevgi Uzun play for Fenerbahce?
items.answer: Yes. Sevgi Uzun played two stints at Fenerbahce (2019 to 2021 and 2023 to 2026) and won the 2024 EuroLeague Women title with the club. She signed a two-year contract with Galatasaray on July 18, 2026.

items.question: Does Sevgi Uzun play for Turkey?
items.answer: Yes. Sevgi Uzun plays for Turkey's national team. At EuroBasket Women 2023 she averaged 13.7 points and 4.3 assists in three games.

items.question: How old is Sevgi Uzun?
items.answer: Sevgi Uzun was born November 25, 1997, in Istanbul, Turkey.

items.question: How tall is Sevgi Uzun?
items.answer: Full Court Buckets lists Sevgi Uzun at 5 feet 10 inches and 141 pounds. She plays guard.
